title: A Cellar for the Smile
author: Beatrix Sandoval
blurb: Emrys Dunmore, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
